name: Photon

images.credit: Vanstrien, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: WiMAX 2.5 GHz, CDMA 800/1900 MHz (EV-DO Rev. A), GSM 850/900/1800/1900 MHz, UMTS/WCDMA 850/1900/2100 MHz (HSPA+ at 14.4 Mbit/s)

Body.Other: Android WebKit with Adobe Flash Player, Mozilla Firefox 4.0.1 in Motorola Webtop mode, eCompass, aGPS with Google Maps, Google Street View, Google Latitude, Android Market

Memory.Storage: 16 GB on board, supports up to 32 GB microSDHC, total 48 GB

Display.Display: 4.3-inch 960×540 px qHD TFT LCD at 275 ppi, 16 M colors, Gorilla Glass

Cameras.Rear camera: 8 MP AF, digital zoom with LED Flash , Capture – 720p MPEG4 and H.264 at 30 frame/s (full 1080p may be supported via software upgrade post-launch)
Cameras.Front camera: VGA imager for video chat, self image capture

Battery.Battery: 1700 mAh, Talk time, WCDMA = 9.1 hrs, GSM = 10.4 hrs, Standby time, WCDMA = 13.1 days, GSM = 12.2 days

Connectivity.Connectivity: audio jack 3.5 mm, Micro USB 2.0 HS, corporate sync, BOTA, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz 802.11 b/g/n, Bluetooth 2.1 EDR, Micro-HDMI
